shell.description: Meet Amanda Hecimovic, Registered Clinical Counsellor, and learn about the kind of therapeutic relationship clients can expect.

intro.title: A steady place to make sense of what you are carrying
paragraphs: I am Amanda Hecimovic, a Registered Clinical Counsellor offering individual counselling for adults in Vancouver and across British Columbia. My work focuses on anxiety, mood, relationships, stress, grief, identity, and life transitions.

In session, we make space to understand patterns, strengthen coping, process difficult experiences, and move toward choices that feel more aligned with your values — at a pace that respects your capacity.

values.title: Therapeutic approach
values.description: Counselling here is collaborative and practical, drawing on person-centred, trauma-informed, and CBT-informed ideas as they fit your goals.

items.title: Collaborative care
items.description: Counselling works best when goals, pace, and focus are shaped together.

items.title: Respect for lived experience
items.description: You bring wisdom about your own life, identities, relationships, and needs.

items.title: Practical support
items.description: Sessions can include reflection, skill-building, nervous system support, and clear next steps.
